description: Complete fatty acid beta-oxidation pathway for saturated and unsaturated fatty acids in Gadus morhua. This pathway was inferred from Homo sapiens pathway Hs_Fatty_acid_beta-oxidation_WP143_20251123.Proteins on this pathway were identified in Gadus morhua using data from FairdomHub repository: [10.15490/fairdomhub.1.study.753.2](https://doi.org/10.15490/fairdomhub.1.study.753.2).
title: Fatty acid beta-oxidation
